requirements.title: ATAN2PI arguments satisfy the source restrictions
requirements.definition: Y shall be real; X shall have the same type and kind type parameter as Y; if Y is zero, X shall not be zero.

pending.atan2pi-y-real: Positive plan: declare real Y with a nonzero sentinel value and call ATAN2PI(Y, X); source-control mutations replace Y with a non-real expression but no diagnostic is claimed because the restriction is unnumbered.
pending.atan2pi-x-same-type-kind-as-y: Positive plan: call ATAN2PI with Y and X of the same selected real kind and compare KIND(ATAN2PI(Y,X)) with KIND(X); source-control mutations use a different kind only as non-diagnostic controls.
pending.atan2pi-not-both-zero-when-y-zero: Positive plan: exercise Y==0 with X initialized to a nonzero real value and separately a nonzero Y; do not ship a Y==0,X==0 negative unless a future numbered diagnostic obligation reaches it.

requirements.title: ATAN2PI result value is a half-revolution atan2 result in the stated range
requirements.definition: The ATAN2PI result is expressed in half-revolutions, lies in the range -1 through 1, and approximates ATAN2(Y,X) divided by pi.
